rows.quote: The medical technology industry is subject to rapid technological changes, and we face significant competition across our product lines and in each market in which our products are sold on the basis of product features, clinical outcomes, price, services and other factors.
rows.note: 顧客側の再認定の記述ゼロ。原本のqualification記述は全て『BDが自社の原材料サプライヤーを認定する』側＝向きが逆。競争は製品特徴・価格・サービスで、中国等の低コスト製造業者の参入が価格圧力と自認→50。

rows.quote: The markets for our products and services are highly competitive. We compete with marketing services companies, credit card issuers, and data processing companies, as well as with the in-house staffs of our current and potential clients.
rows.note: 『integrated end-to-end』『long-standing client relationships』は自社の売り込み文で顧客側の負担の記述なし。むしろ顧客の内製が競合と自認し複数年契約も期限つき→50。

rows.quote: Since most of our advertisers are not bound by long-term contracts, they may amend or terminate advertising arrangements with us easily without incurring liabilities.
rows.note: 会社自身が顧客の離脱が容易で違約負担も無いと明記＝移行摩擦の不在の直接記述。ユーザー側の巨大なトラフィックの印象は強いが、irrの刻みは顧客側の負担で裁く→50。

rows.quote: We generally have limited competition for the retail distribution of electricity and natural gas in our service areas.
rows.note: 規制下の配給地域で競争が限定的と原本が述べ、独立販売業者に販売を奪われても『we still collect a distribution charge for transporting the gas through our distribution network』＝配給網は迂回不能。ただし唯一供給の断定も顧客側の再認定の記述も無い→70。

rows.quote: There are competitors in each category in which the Company sells its products, and the competition varies from moderate to intense.
rows.note: 競合を実名で列挙（Sensus/Neptune/Elster）し、競争の要素は『price, product technology, quality and service』、官公庁入札では『continued intense price competition』と自認。顧客側の再認定・認定名簿の記述なし→50。

rows.quote: Because of the technical standards required to meet U.S. Government contracting requirements for nuclear components and the barriers to entry present in this type of environment, competition in this segment is limited.
rows.note: 2013年ビンテージには顧客側の再認定の断定が無く、これは『参入障壁が高い』の一般論（規約が85から明示除外）。ASME N-Stampは当社が取得する側の認定で除外。『the only heavy nuclear component manufacturer in North America』と同一書類の『two of only a few North American suppliers』が矛盾するため100も採らず→70。

rows.quote: Caterpillar products and product support services are sold worldwide into a variety of highly competitive markets. In all markets, we compete on the basis of product performance, customer service, quality and price. From time to time, the intensity of competition results in price discounting in a particular industry or region.
rows.note: 世界的ディーラー網と規模の印象は強いが、原本は価格競争と値引きを自認し、顧客側の再認定・設計組込の記述は無い→50。

rows.quote: The commercial real estate market is highly competitive. Numerous commercial properties compete with our properties for tenants.
rows.note: 政府機関・防衛請負の『specialized requirements』に特化とあるが、それは当社の戦略の記述で借主側の移行負担ではない。データセンター区画の特殊性の記述も当社の転用困難＝向きが逆→50。

rows.quote: A substantial portion of our products and raw materials are commodities whose prices fluctuate as supply and demand fundamentals change.
rows.note: Advanced Engineered Materialsの『strong specification position』は数値も顧客側の負担も伴わない自称。全社ベースではアセチル系のコモディティが中核で競合を実名列挙→50。

rows.quote: We operate in a highly competitive industry with a large number of participants, some of which have financial and other resources that are greater than ours.
rows.note: 競馬・賭博の免許は当社が取得する側の資格（規約の85から除外）。顧客は他のカジノ・宝くじ・ネット賭博へ自由に移れると原本自身が述べる→50。

rows.quote: The markets for consumer products are highly competitive. Most of the Company’s products compete with other nationally advertised brands within each category and with “private label” brands.
rows.note: ブランドの印象は中程度だが、原本はプライベートブランドとの競合・継続的な広告投下が必要と述べ、顧客（小売・消費者）側の移行負担の記述は皆無。上位5顧客で売上44%＝むしろ小売側が強い→50。

rows.quote: Competition We operate in both the DIY and Commercial markets of the automotive aftermarket industry. Our primary competitors are (i) both national and regional retail chains of automotive parts stores, including AutoZone, Inc., O'Reilly Automotive, Inc. and The Pep Boys-Manny, Moe & Jack, (ii) discount stores and mass merchandisers that carry automotive products, (iii) wholesalers or jobber stores, including those associated with national parts distributors or associations, such as NAPA and Carquest, (iv) independent operators, (v) automobile dealers that supply parts and (vi) internet-based parts providers.
rows.note: 原本が6類型の競合を名指しし『The principal methods of competition ... include customer service, product offerings, availability, quality, price and store location』と価格・立地競争を明言。認定・再認定の記述はゼロ（certificationの語はASEの整備士研修とSOX証明のみ）。

rows.quote: Competition We compete with a number of developers, owners and operators of retail, office, multifamily and mixed-use real estate, many of which own properties similar to ours in the same markets in which our properties are located and some of which have greater financial resources than we do.
rows.note: REIT。原本自ら『own properties similar to ours in the same markets』と代替の存在を述べ、テナント獲得は賃料・立地の競争。barriers to entryの語は自社の物件取得戦略（高参入障壁の市場を選ぶ）の話で顧客側の負担ではない。

rows.quote: Competition The market for our services is highly competitive. We believe we offer a comprehensive set of solutions for our clients that few competitors, if any, can match. However, competition exists for each of the individual solutions we provide. Factors in this competition include speed, accuracy, price, customer service and the quality of supporting products and services.
rows.note: 開示管理サービスの小規模事業者。個別ソリューションごとに競合が存在し価格・速度で競うと自認。『single source provider』は当社が一括提供者という意味で唯一供給ではない。移行障壁・認定の記述なし。

rows.quote: COMPETITION The markets for our products and services are characterized by intense competition, new industry standards, evolving business and distribution models, disruptive software and hardware technology developments, frequent new product introductions, short product life cycles, price cutting with resulting downward pressure on gross margins and price sensitivity on the part of consumers.
rows.note: Apple/Corel/Microsoft/Quark等を名指しし『lower-end offerings available on touch-enabled devices via app stores』『various open source initiatives』まで挙げる。統合は『work well together, providing broader functionality and shortened product training time』と機能便益として書かれるだけで、移行費用・再認定の記述は無い（switchingの語は全文ゼロ）。

料金規制の電力・ガス会社。全文で『we compete』が0回、競合の語も1回のみ＝代替可能性を論じる記述自体が無い。探したもの: qualification/certification（SOX証明とDOEの小型炉設計認証のみ）／sole・only supplier／barriers to entry／exclusive service territory／monopoly（いずれも該当なし）。逆にイリノイでは『customers switching to alternative retail electric suppliers』と供給の選択が現に起きており、規制フランチャイズの記述は用語集の native load 定義（obligated to serve by statute, franchise）に留まる。門の刻みに落ちる記述が無いのでnull。

rows.quote: Competition AFG's annuity businesses operate in highly competitive markets. They compete with other insurers and financial institutions based on many factors, including: (i) ratings; (ii) financial strength; (iii) reputation; (iv) service to policyholders and agents; (v)
rows.note: 損保側も『The property and casualty group operates in a highly competitive industry』とし、代理店・ブローカー経由で価格・手数料が競争要因と明記。認定・再認定の記述なし（certificationはSOX証明のみ）。

rows.quote: Competition The market for our services is intensely competitive and characterized by rapidly changing technology, evolving industry standards and frequent new product and service innovations. We expect competition for our services to increase both from existing competitors and new market entrants.
rows.note: 競争要因の末尾に price を挙げ、MD&Aで『Our unit prices offered to some customers have declined as a result of increased competition』と実際の値下げを開示。顧客の内製化（in-house technology solutions）も代替として自認。switching costs / barriers to entry の語は全文に無い。

rows.quote: Certain of our marketed products face — and our product candidates, if approved, are also expected to face — substantial competition. Our products' competitive positions among other biological and pharmaceutical products may be based on, among other things, safety, efficacy, reliability, availability, patient convenience/delivery devices, price, reimbursement, timing of market entry and patent position and expirations.
rows.note: 障壁は自社取得の特許・規制上の地位（85の除外対象）で、原本自身が治療上の代替との実質競争とバイオシミラーによる特許失効後の競争を述べる。なお『must be obtained from that specific sole source ... could not be obtained from another supplier unless and until the regulatory agency approved such supplier』という再認定型の機構文は存在するが、これは**Amgenが顧客側**（自社の原材料・部材の供給者に対する記述）＝向きが逆なので当社のirrの証拠にならない。

rows.quote: Competition The Corporation faces considerable competition from a large number of companies in both segments. The Corporation believes, however, that it is a significant factor in each of the niche markets which it serves. Competition in both segments is based on quality, service, price and delivery.
rows.note: 原本自ら『a large number of companies』と多数供給者を認め、競争軸に price と delivery を挙げる。ニッチでの地位の自称はあるが数値・認定の記述なし。受注残$196百万の開示はあるが顧客側の負担の記述ではない。

rows.quote: A considerable amount of research, time and coordination with our customers is required to qualify a pump for use with their products.
rows.note: 顧客製品に合わせた qualify（設計組込）と、医薬では『a significant amount of time and research from initially working with pharmaceutical companies at the molecular development stage』『We may potentially work for years on modifying our dispensing device to work in conjunction with a customer's drug formulation』＝長期の組込。さらに資本集約とグローバル生産が『serve as barriers to entry』と明記。ただし**顧客が替える際に再認定・データ再生成をやり直すという断定が無い**（requalify/customers must generate 型の文はゼロ）ので85ではなく70。反対材料として『All of the markets in which we operate are highly competitive and we continue to experience price competition in all product lines and markets』も併存。

rows.quote: Competition The sale of women's intimate and other apparel, personal care and beauty products and accessories through retail stores is a highly competitive business with numerous competitors, including individual and chain specialty stores, department stores and discount retailers. Brand image, marketing, design, price, service, assortment and quality are the principal competitive factors in retail store sales.
rows.note: 原本が『numerous competitors』と価格を含む競争要因を明記し、『In many cases, our competitors sell their products in stores that are located in the same shopping malls as our stores』と物理的に隣接する代替まで述べる。堀はブランドだが移行障壁・認定の記述はゼロ。

rows.quote: Competition – We face strong competition in each of the markets in which we operate. In North America, other large, nationally recognized companies compete against our salt products. In addition, there are also several smaller regional producers of salt. There are several importers of salt into North America
rows.note: 塩・SOPの商品。原本は多数の大小競合と輸入業者の存在を自ら述べ、切替障壁・認定の記述は皆無（qualification/certified byはSOX証明書のみ）。堀の実体は鉱山の立地と輸送費であって顧客側の移行障壁ではない。

rows.quote: Once a product is designed into a system, customers may be reluctant to change the incumbent supplier due to the extensive qualification process and potential redesign required in using alternative sources.
rows.note: 設計組込済みの製品について、代替源を使うには顧客側で広範な qualification と再設計が要ると断定＝TDG型（他社を認定する費用が抑止になる）。ただし『may be reluctant』と緩和されており、事業自体は原本が『highly competitive』と自認する。

rows.quote: The contact lens market is highly competitive. CooperVision's three largest competitors in the worldwide market and its primary competitors in the spherical, toric and multifocal lens categories of that market are Johnson & Johnson Vision Care, Inc., CIBA Vis
rows.note: コンタクトレンズ。競合3社を名指しし『intense competition』と自認。認証はISO13485・CEマーク＝いずれも当社が取得する側で除外型。顧客(検眼医・患者)側の再認定の記述なし。

rows.quote: The company experiences worldwide competition in all of its principal products. This competition arises from numerous competitors of varying sizes across multiple food and beverage categories, and includes producers of generic and private label products, as well as other branded food and beverage manufacturers.
rows.note: 食品ブランド。原本自身が『numerous competitors』『The number of competitors cannot be reliably estimated』と述べ、競争軸はブランド・味・価格・販促＝代替容易側。認定・切替障壁の記述は皆無。

rows.quote: This segment faces competition from numerous competitors that produce roofing, insulation, and waterproofing products for commercial and residential applications. The level of competition within this market varies by product line.
rows.note: 多角化産業体。屋根材は多数競合、輸送用は低コスト国と価格競争、建材は『competes through pricing』と自認。買収の無形資産に『customer certifications and approvals』(耐用3年・$1.0百万)が1行あるだけで、顧客側の再認定を述べる本文はない。

rows.quote: Under this proposal, CSX would be required to allow a competing railroad to access certain customers that are currently solely served by CSX's network.
rows.note: 物理網への深い統合＝一部顧客は当社網でしか運べないと原本が述べる（規制提案の文脈だが現状の断定）。一方で競争節は『highly competitive』でトラック・NSとの価格競争を述べる。認定・再認定の機構は一切なしゆえ85には当たらず70。

rows.quote: The intensely competitive IT services and outsourcing market includes a large number of participants and is subject to rapid change.
rows.note: ITサービス。原本自身が参加者多数・急速な変化と自認し、上位5社比率も14%と分散。認定・規格ロックの記述を検索したがSOX証明書しか出ない。

rows.quote: In order to sell our products, we and the products we manufacture must also be certified by our individual OEM customers.
rows.note: OEM顧客自身が当社と当社製品を認定する、と断定（加えてFAA/EASAが部品ごとにqualification requirementsを課し、原子力ではN-stamp・AP1000冷却材ポンプの単独供給）。顧客側・当局側の双方に認定が乗る典型の85型。

rows.quote: We face substantial competition from a number of experienced companies, including state-sponsored entities and major shipping companies. Some of these competitors have significantly greater financial resources than we do, and can therefore operate larger fleets and may be able to offer bett
rows.note: コンテナ船の定期用船。原本は入札が『competitiveness of the bid in terms of overall price』で決まり新規参入も来ると述べる。船級協会のISM/クラス認証は当社が維持する側＝除外型。顧客(定期用船者)側の再認定の記述なし。

rows.quote: While there has been significant consolidation in the diagnostic information services industry in recent years, our industry remains fragmented and highly competitive. We primarily compete with three types of clinical testing providers: commercial clinical laboratories, hospital-affiliated laboratories and physician-office laboratories.
rows.note: 臨床検査。原本が明示的に『remains fragmented and highly competitive』＝50の残余刻みの典型。CLIA認証・ISO・CCHIT認証はいずれも当社が取得する側。Care360の接続性で『increased customer loyalty』と述べるが顧客側の再認定負担の断定はない。

rows.quote: The market for career services is highly competitive and barriers to entry in the market are relatively low. For example, there are tens of thousands of job boards currently operating on the Internet, and new competitors may emerge. We do not own any patented technology that would preclude or inhibit competitors from entering the re
rows.note: 求人サイト。参入障壁が低いと自認し、求人掲載は単一チャネル専属でないため競合が同等の掲載束を作れるとまで書く＝代替容易の断定。認定・移行障壁の記述なし。

rows.quote: The retail industry is highly competitive and we expect competition to increase in the future.
rows.note: FY2013/2/2 10-K(filed 2013-03-15)。Competition節は価格・立地での競争と競合種別(single-price/multi-price dollar store・mass merchandiser等)の列挙のみ。顧客側の移行障壁・認定の記述はゼロ＝代替容易の50。

rows.quote: In general, most of our businesses are market leaders that compete with only a few companies, and the key competitive factors are customer service, product quality, price, and innovation.
rows.note: FY2012 10-K。競争要因に価格が明記され、全end marketで競合を実名列挙。航空防衛部品を持つのに qualification/certification は年金・SOX文脈のみで顧客側の再認定記述は無し→70の根拠も立たず50。

rows.quote: We have invested in the past, and will continue to invest in the future, in merchandising and customer equipment consisting primarily of systems used by customers to dispense our products as well as to monitor water systems.
rows.note: 顧客先に当社の投薬・監視機器を設置しCIP process control systemsを設計設置、複数拠点一括の『Circle the Customer』＝深い統合で70。ただし顧客側の再認定の断定は無く、Competition節は『competition is based on customer support, product performance and price』と価格競争も認める。

rows.quote: The private education sector in China is rapidly evolving, highly fragmented and competitive, and we expect competition in this sector to persist and intensify.
rows.note: FY2012(5月期)20-F(filed 2012-10-12)。会社自身がfragmentedと明言し各プログラム・各都市で競合を実名列挙。移行障壁は生徒側にゼロ＝50。

rows.quote: All of our industrial properties are subject to significant local competition.
rows.note: FY2012 10-K。産業用不動産REITで、テナント獲得も物件取得も競争と明記。qualification/certification/switchingの語は堀の文脈で一つも無い＝50。

rows.quote: Many of the intermediates products in the Specialty Fluids & Intermediates segment are priced based on supply and demand of substitute and competing products.
rows.note: FY2012 10-K。acetate tow(世界2大手・売上16%)は参入障壁ありと述べるが根拠は高資本コスト＝供給側の一般論で顧客側負担の記述なし。他segmentは代替品との価格連動・acetate yarnはポリエステルへの代替進行を自認→全社では50。

rows.quote: We compete with a number of major international manufacturers and distributors, as well as a large number of smaller, regional competitors.
rows.note: FY2013/3期 10-K(filed 2013-05-28)。『The industrial battery market is highly competitive』『extremely competitive industry and are subject to pricing pressures』。TPPL技術で『we believe we are the only manufacturer』とあるが自社技術の話で用途の唯一供給ではなく、100の要件を満たさない。

rows.quote: Once customers have an established data center footprint, either through a relationship with one of our competitors or through in-sourcing, it may be extremely difficult to convince them to relocate to our IBX data centers.
rows.note: FY2012 10-K。既設フットプリントの移設が極めて困難と原本が断定＝顧客側の移行費用。さらにcross connect/『network effect』の相互接続エコシステムで深い統合。ただし第三者や顧客による再認定の記述は無いので85ではなく70。

rows.quote: Escalade is subject to competition with various manufacturers in each product line produced or sold by Escalade.
rows.note: FY2012 10-K。全製品ラインで競合、量販・オンライン小売との販路競争、『Some competitors are larger and have substantially greater resources』。堀の根拠はブランドと顧客関係のみ＝50。

FY2012 10-K。刻みが社内で割れるため空欄——配電は『ComEd remains the distribution service provider for all customers in its service territory』『generally exclusive from competition from other electric and natural gas utilities』＝実質唯一供給(100側)だが、Generation/Constellationは商品市況・小売供給は77社のEGSと競合し顧客が現に switching(50側)。domの全社ベース規約(違う刻みに散るときは空欄)に倣った。

rows.quote: The industrial, construction, and maintenance supply industry, although consolidating, still remains a large, fragmented industry that is highly competitive.
rows.note: FY2012 10-K。会社自身がfragmented・highly competitiveと明言し競争要因は『customer service, price, convenience, product availability』。産業用ベンディングは『not easily replicated』と自称するが顧客側の負担の記述はなく自称にとどまる＝50（逆に『customers may choose to disqualify us as a supplier』と顧客が外す側の記述あり）。

rows.quote: The principal methods of competition in the biodiesel industry are price, supply reliability, biodiesel quality and RIN integrity
rows.note: 売上54%の biodiesel は原本自身が『biodiesel is a commodity with a large potential customer base』と述べ価格競争。化学側は custom manufacturing の長期契約だが顧客側の再認定の記述は皆無で、除草剤顧客は generic competition で数量を38%削減＝ロックが効いていない。

rows.quote: The investment management business is highly competitive. Competition is particularly intense among mutual fund providers. According to the Investment Company Institute, at the end of 2012 , there were approximately 7,600 open-end mutual funds of varying sizes and investment objectives whose shares are currently being offered to the public both on a sales-load and no-sales-load basis.
rows.note: 原本が同等品7,600本の存在と激しい競争を自認。qualification/certification/switching の語は Sarbanes-Oxley 証明書の定型文以外に出現なし。

rows.quote: The majority of our revenue is generated from recurring account- and transaction-based fees under contracts that generally have terms of three to five years. We also have had high contract renewal rates with our clients. The majority of the services we provide are necessary for our clients to operate their business and are, therefore, non-discretionary in nature.
rows.note: 3-5年契約・高い更新率・非裁量サービス・conversion expenses と early contract termination fees の存在＝深い統合と移行摩擦。ただし顧客側の再認定の断定は無く、契約満了時は『consider whether to engage one of our competitors』と再入札を自認するので85には届かない。

rows.quote: Competition from generic agrochemical producers is significant as a number of key product patents held industry-wide have expired in the last decade.
rows.note: ジェネリック競争と『The principal method of competition in the sale of hydrogen peroxide to commodity markets is price』＝価格競争を自認。医薬excipient(MCC)は顧客の製剤再バリデーションが起きうる型だが、原本はその負担を一言も書いていないので憶測せず50。

rows.quote: Numerous commercial developers and real estate companies compete with us in seeking tenants for our existing properties and properties for acquisition.
rows.note: テナント獲得で多数の競合と競う、と原本が明言。立地の『high barriers to entry』は当社の取得側の話で、テナント側の移行費用・再認定の記述は無い。

rows.quote: The segments of the freight transportation industry we participate in are highly competitive, very fragmented and historically have few barriers to entry.
rows.note: 原本自身が fragmented・参入障壁ほぼ無しと明言。競争は『service, on-time delivery, flexibility and reliability, as well as rates』＝役務と価格。

rows.quote: The operating cycle of many of our major platform programs can result in sustained periods of program continuity when we perform successfully.
rows.note: 現行プログラムでの incumbency と長い platform サイクルによる継続性＝高摩擦。ただし顧客(DoD)側が別供給者を認定し直す費用の記述は無く、Gulfstream の FAA type certification は当社が自ら取得する側なので85の条件に当たらない。

rows.quote: There are many commercially available products for the treatment of these diseases. Many companies and institutions are making substantial investments in developing additional products to treat these diseases.
rows.note: 原本は多数の代替薬とジェネリック(didanosine/zidovudine/stavudine/lamivudine、2013-14のefavirenz)による浸食を具体的に列挙。堀は特許＝自社が取得する側で、顧客側の再認定の型ではない。

rows.quote: Competition arises primarily from other LNG carrier owners, some of whom have substantially greater resources than we do. Furthermore, new competitors with greater resources could enter the market for LNG carriers and FSRUs and operate larger fleets through consolidations, acquisitions or the purchase of new vessels, and may be able to offer lower charter rates and more modern fleets.
rows.note: 用船獲得は『intensive screening process and competitive bids』＝競争入札で、勝てば長期契約だが供給者は多数・より安い用船料で奪われうると自認。船級協会の certification は当社が維持する側。

rows.quote: Under the extension, the Company will be sourced virtually all Chrysler interior auto-dimming rearview mirrors through 2015.
rows.note: 車種プログラム単位で設計組込・複数年ソーシング契約(世界シェア88%)。ただし顧客側の再認定・再試験の記述は無く、Ford/GM は長期契約終了後 purchase order ベース＝85には届かない。

rows.quote: Our stations also compete for advertising revenue with other media, such as newspapers, radio stations, magazines, outdoor advertising, transit advertising, yellow page directories, direct mail, internet websites, local cable and other MVPD systems.
rows.note: 広告主は多数の代替媒体へ移れると原本が列挙。視聴者・番組・広告のすべてで競争すると明記し、移行障壁や顧客側の認定の記述は無い。

rows.quote: The industries we serve are highly competitive, and we have many substantial competitors.
rows.note: Competition節が自ら「highly competitive markets throughout the world」「many substantial competitors」と述べ、競争要因の筆頭にpriceを挙げる。qualif/switch/approved supplierを全走査したが顧客側の再認定・移行障壁の記述はゼロ（qualifのヒットは監査意見のunqualified opinionと税制上のnonqualified stock optionのみ）。

rows.quote: because the industry in which we operate is not particularly capital intensive or otherwise subject to high barriers to entry, it is relatively easy for new competitors to emerge who will compete with us for our distributors and customers
rows.note: 会社自身が低参入障壁を明言。re-qualification のヒットは多数あるが全て自社のsales leaderが年1回売上基準を満たし直す社内制度の話で、顧客側の再認定ではない（むしろ51.8%しか再認定されない＝流動性の高さの証拠）。

rows.quote: Transitions to new suppliers may result in significant costs and delays, including those related to the required recertification of parts obtained from new suppliers with our customers and/or regulatory agencies.
rows.note: 航空宇宙の認証体制が原本に明記され、部品供給者の交代には顧客・規制当局との再認定が要ると述べる。ただし主語はHON自身が供給者を替える場合＝負担がHON側に落ちる向きで、顧客がHONを外す場合の再認定負担は一言も書かれていないため85ではなく70。Competition節は「active competition in substantially all product and service areas」「considerable price competition」とも述べる。

rows.quote: Hubbell experiences substantial competition in all categories of its business, but does not compete with the same companies in all of its product categories.
rows.note: qualif/switch/approved/specification/code/standard を全走査。ヒットは年金のqualified plansと製品名のSwitchesのみで、顧客の再認定も設計組込も切替費用も一切記述なし。堀の記述はブランド列挙（Hubbell/Burndy/Ohio Brass等）と「design and manufacture high quality products at the lowest possible cost」＝コスト競争の自認。

rows.quote: The company participates in a highly competitive environment, where its competitors vary by industry segment, and range from large multinational enterprises to smaller, more narrowly focused entities. Overall, across its business segments, the company recognizes hundreds of competitors worldwide.
rows.note: switch/migrat/lock-in/installed base を走査したが移行障壁の記述はゼロ。知財についても『its business as a whole is not materially dependent on any particular patent or license』と自ら依存を否定。競争優位として挙げるのはglobal reach and scale・client relationships＝規模と関係であって顧客側の再認定ではない。

rows.quote: The Company's businesses participate in highly competitive markets. IDEX believes that the principal points of competition are product quality, price, design and engineering capabilities, product development, conformity to customer specifications, quality of post-sale support, timeliness of delivery, and effectiveness of our distribution channels.
rows.note: 『custom-engineered OEM pumps』『meet exacting original equipment manufacturer specifications』『increased content on OEM platforms』というOEM設計組込を示唆する記述はあるが、いずれもセグメント紹介の製品説明であって障壁の主張ではない。会社自身が競争要因の筆頭群にpriceを置き『Most of our products are sold in competitive markets』と述べるため、記述に忠実に50。

rows.quote: We face intense competition in all of our businesses, both domestically and internationally.
rows.note: switching/lock-in/retention rate/データ移行の困難さを走査したが一件もヒットなし。むしろ『the barriers to entry are lower than they are for desktop software products and services』とオンライン領域の低障壁を自認し、無料・低価格競合への言及が続く。QuickBooksを『the leading small business financial management software』と述べるのは順位の自称。

rows.quote: Once a customer places physical records in storage with us, and until those records are destroyed or permanently removed (for which we typically receive a service fee), we receive recurring payments for storage rental without incurring additional labor or marketing expenses or significant capital costs.
rows.note: 顧客が離脱するには『customer termination and permanent withdrawal fees』を払う＝退出費用が顧客側に落ちることを原本が明記（複数箇所）。移行摩擦としては本物だが、第三者や顧客による用途の再認定は一切登場しないため85ではなく70。同じ10-Kが『highly competitive and includes thousands of competitors』とも述べる点は割引材料。

rows.quote: Limited barriers to entry exist in the markets in which we do business. As a result, new competitors may emerge and existing competitors may start to provide additional or complementary services.
rows.note: 会社自身が低参入障壁を2箇所で明言。差別化として挙げるのは研究コンテンツの広さ・1,405人のアナリスト・47言語＝規模と品質であって顧客側の移行費用ではない。契約更新率への言及はあるが解約の障壁としては述べられていない。

rows.quote: there are relatively few barriers to entry by new investment management firms, and the successful efforts of new entrants into our various distribution channels around the world have also resulted in increased competition
rows.note: 会社自身が低参入障壁を明言。Competition節は『The investment management business is highly competitive』『We face strong competition in every market in which we operate』と述べ、fee pressureも自認。qualificationのヒットは規制上の人材ライセンス要件のみで顧客側の再認定ではない。

rows.quote: Our businesses operate in highly competitive markets. We compete against national and regional manufacturers and distributors on the basis of price, quality, product variety and effective distribution.
rows.note: Item1も『Snack food and bakery products markets are highly competitive』と述べ、競合が自社より大きく資源も多いと自認。原材料・カップ・ストロー・蓋は『readily available from various suppliers』、冷凍飲料ディスペンサーも複数社から調達＝代替容易な供給構造。顧客側の再認定・設計組込の記述は皆無。

rows.quote: As a bottler and manufacturer, we also compete with a number of smaller bottlers and distributors and a variety of smaller, regional and private label manufacturers, such as The Cott Corporation ("Cott"). Smaller companies may be more innovative, better able to bring new products to market and better able to quickly exploit and serve niche markets.
rows.note: COMPETITION節が『The LRB industry is highly competitive』で、競争軸は brand recognition, taste, quality, price と列挙。多数の大手＋地域・PBメーカーが同等品を供給と自認＝代替容易の50。認証・移行障壁の記述はゼロ。

rows.quote: We compete in highly competitive markets against well-known, branded products and low-cost or private label products both domestically and internationally.
rows.note: 『several major competitors in most of our markets』＋PB・低コスト・新興国メーカーとの価格競争を自認。顧客側の再認定も切替コストも記述なし＝50。特許・商標は自社取得側で85の対象外。

rows.quote: The clinical laboratory business is intensely competitive both in terms of price and service. Pricing of laboratory testing services is often one of the most significant factors used by health care providers and third-party payers in selecting a laboratory.
rows.note: CMS推計で全米約5,600の独立検査ラボが存在し、選択要因の筆頭が価格と自認＝代替容易の50。CLIA認証・CAP認定は当社が取得する側で85に当たらない。

rows.quote: Accordingly, when our branded pharmaceutical loses its market exclusivity, it normally faces intense price competition from generic forms of the product.
rows.note: 堀の根拠は自社が取得する特許・データ独占期間で、規約上85の対象外。原本は独占期間の失効と同時に『severe and rapid decline in sales』＝顧客側に移行費用が一切無いことを自ら述べる。よって50。

rows.quote: The market for athletic apparel is highly competitive. It includes increasing competition from established companies who are expanding their production and marketing of performance products, as well as from frequent new entrants to the market.
rows.note: 競争軸は brand image, product quality, innovation, style, distribution and price と自認し、新規参入が頻繁と明記＝50。生地の第三者検査は当社が発注する試験で顧客側の再認定ではない。

rows.quote: our customers’ willingness to replace their currently deployed software solutions
rows.note: 既存導入品の置換意思が販売の律速と自認＝据付済みシステムの移行摩擦。ERP・EC・MHEとの統合実装、支援契約の年次更新率90%超が裏付け。顧客側の再認定の断定は無いので85ではなく70。

rows.quote: Customers moving from entry-level designs to those requiring real-time emulation are able to preserve their investment in learning and tools as they migrate to future PIC devices since all of our PIC and dsPIC development tools share the same integrated development environment.
rows.note: 独自PICアーキテクチャへの学習・ツール投資の蓄積（第三者ツールベンダ約200社）と顧客製品への組込＝スイッチングコスト型の70。ただし原本は『intensely competitive and has been characterized by price erosion』とも述べ、顧客側の再認定の記述は無い。

rows.quote: There are various weight loss products and programs within the highly competitive weight-loss industry. These include a wide variety of commercial weight-loss programs, pharmaceutical products, books, self-help diets, dietary supplements, appetite suppressants, and meal replacements.
rows.note: 代替手段が多数存在すると原本自身が列挙し、競合も名指し（NutriSystem・Herbalife等）＝代替容易の50。認証・組込・切替費用の記述は全文走査で皆無。

rows.quote: The commercial foodservice and food processing equipment industries are highly competitive and fragmented.
rows.note: 市場がfragmentedと明言＝規約(3)の残余刻み50。3,000人の認定技術者網は当社が認定する側であり、顧客の側が再認定を負う型ではない。

rows.quote: Few barriers exist to prevent insurers from entering our segments of the P&C industry.
rows.note: 参入障壁がほぼ無いと原本自身が断定＝50。ソフト市場では標準保険会社が専門分野に流入し価格が悪化するとも記述。移行障壁の記述はゼロ。

rows.quote: The complex nature of competitive bidding and required investment in subject-matter expertise, repeatable processes and support infrastructure creates significant barriers to entry for potential new competitors unfamiliar with the nature of government procurement.
rows.note: 複雑なRFP手続と実績要件による長い評価期間・複数年契約（backlog+オプション更新で翌期売上の90%）＝70。ただし顧客側の再認定は無く、これは新規参入者に対する一般的参入障壁の主張なので85には当たらない。契約は periodic rebids で定期的に再入札される点は反対材料。

rows.quote: We compete in a rapidly evolving and highly competitive industry, and expect competition will continue to intensify as consolidations and mergers occur with communication companies. Regulatory developments and technological advances over the past several years have increased opportunities for alternative communications service providers, which in turn have increased competitive pressures on our business.
rows.note: 原本は競争激化と『Alternatives to our service…permit the bypassing of our local exchange network』を自ら列挙。認証・再認定の記述は皆無で、顧客側の負担ゼロ＝代替容易。

rows.quote: Advantages or disadvantages in any of these competitive factors may be sufficient to cause the customer to consider changing suppliers and/or using an alternative form of packaging.
rows.note: ガラス容器。原本が『顧客が供給者を替える／別素材へ移る』と明言。競合(Ball/Crown/Rexam/Silgan)を名指し、価格・品質での競争と述べる。

rows.quote: While many of our client relationships are long-standing, from time to time clients put their advertising, marketing and corporate communications services business up for competitive review. We have won and lost accounts in the past as a result of these reviews.
rows.note: 広告持株会社。長期関係はあるが原本自身が競合レビューでの失注と『clients generally are able to…cancel projects at any time on short notice for any reason』を認める＝移行障壁なし。

rows.quote: Auctions can be either closed (restricted to certain eligible dealers) or open (available to all eligible dealers) and inventory feeds of vehicles are automated with many customers' systems as well as third party providers that are integrated with various dealer management systems.
rows.note: 顧客システムとの自動連携＋『High barriers to entry』の物理網。ただし顧客側の再認定の断定は無く、salvage側の統合は『We seek to become integrated』と願望形、whole car側は『supply of vehicles from dealers is dispersed among all of the auctions』＝85には届かない。

rows.quote: Our businesses operate in highly competitive markets. Our beverage, snack and food brands compete against global, regional, local and private label manufacturers and other value competitors.
rows.note: ブランドと配送網は強いが、原本は価格・品質・品揃え・配送での競争と述べるのみ。顧客(小売・消費者)側に再認定の負担が生じる記述は皆無。

rows.quote: This means that generic competitors can market a competing version of our product after the expiration or loss of our patent and often charge much less.
rows.note: 堀は自社取得の特許＝規約が85から明示除外する型。しかも原本は薬剤師が『must substitute』させられる法制まで記述し、独占期間終了後の代替は即時。

rows.quote: The containerboard and corrugated products industry is highly competitive, with no single containerboard or corrugated packaging producer having a dominant position. Containerboard cannot generally be differentiated by producer, which tends to intensify price competition.
rows.note: 原本が『生産者による差別化ができない』と自認するコモディティ。ISO9002は自社が取得する側の認証で85に当たらない。

rows.quote: Although some very limited retail competition existed in APS's service area in 1999 and 2000, there are currently no active retail competitors offering unbundled energy or other utility services to APS's customers.
rows.note: 規制区域の電力小売。原本が『現在この用途で他の供給者は存在しない』と述べる＝100の型（認証ロックではなく唯一供給）。留保: 同10-Kは太陽光自家設置業者の参入とACCによる小売自由化再検討をリスクに挙げる。

rows.quote: We face competition in both of the markets we serve - owned portfolio and fee-for-service receivables management - from new and existing providers of outsourced receivables management services, including other purchasers of defaulted consumer receivables portfolios, contingent fee businesses and debt owners that manage their own defaulted consumer receivables.
rows.note: 債権買取・回収。原本は『bidding competition』での競り合いと述べる。挙げる障壁(資本・評価力・規制順守)は業界一般論で顧客側の負担ではない。

rows.quote: The apparel industry is competitive as a result of its fashion orientation, mix of large and small producers, the flow of domestic and imported merchandise and the wide diversity of retailing methods.
rows.note: アパレル。原本自身が大小混在・輸入品流入の競争と述べる。堀はブランド(Calvin Klein/Tommy)だが、顧客の再認定という機構は一切無い。

rows.quote: Product Qualifications. Many of the products we produce are qualified for the application by the OEM, the U.S. Department of Defense, the FAA or a combination of these agencies. These credentials have been achieved for thousands of distinct items after years of design, testing and improvement.
rows.note: 85の定型そのもの——第三者(OEM/DoD/FAA)が用途ごとに認定し、既に達成済み。補強: 『We currently have in excess of 36,500 of such approvals…in many of these instances we are the only approved supplier of a given bearing product』（D認定業者名簿型も併存）。

rows.quote: The beverage industry is highly competitive. The principal areas of competition are pricing, packaging, development of new products and flavors as well as promotional and marketing strategies. Our products compete with a wide range of drinks produced by a relatively large number of companies, many of which have substantially greater financial, marketing and distribution resources than we do.
rows.note: 多数の競合が同種商品を供給し、棚と流通の取り合い（『secure adequate shelf space』『price erosion』も自認）。顧客側の再認定も設計組込も一切なし＝代替容易の50。ブランドと流通契約は強いが、原本は移行障壁を一言も述べない。

rows.quote: Because crop nutrients are global commodities available from numerous sources, crop nutrition companies compete primarily on the basis of delivered price.
rows.note: 原本が自ら『global commodities available from numerous sources』『compete primarily on the basis of delivered price』と明言＝50の教科書例。堀は鉱区とCanpotexの物流であって移行障壁ではない。

rows.quote: our customers usually complete an in-depth technical evaluation of our products before they place a purchase order; • the commercial adoption of our products by OEMs and ODMs is typically limited during the initial release of their product to evaluate product performance and consumer demand; • our products must be designed into a customer’s product or system;
rows.note: 設計組込＋長い技術評価は明記されるが、顧客側の再認定の断定は無く85には届かない。しかも文脈は『in an attempt to achieve design wins』『no assurance that the OEMs will continue to incorporate our ICs』＝願望形。競合『at least 10 manufacturers』の自認もあり70の下寄り。

rows.quote: Many of our clients have come to rely on our products in their investment management processes, integrating our products into their performance measurement and risk management processes, where they become an integral part of their daily portfolio management functions. In certain cases, our clients are requested by their customers to report using our tools or data. Additionally, our tools can help clients comply with local regulations or client reporting requirements. Consequently, we believe that certain of our clients may experience business disruption and additional costs if they choose to cease using or replace our products.
rows.note: 『替えれば顧客側に業務中断と追加費用が生じる』と完了形で断定＝深い統合・スイッチングコストの明文化。ただし再認定・再試験の機構は無く、同じ原本が『barriers to entry may be low』『clients ... could change the index to a non-MSCI index』とも述べるので85ではなく70。

rows.quote: customers will continue to invest in our next-generation systems with the assurance that new radios with enhanced features remain interoperable and backward-compatible
rows.note: 既設無線網との後方互換＝インストールベースの移行摩擦は述べるが、顧客側の再認定は無い。むしろ標準必須特許を『licenses to those patents on fair, reasonable and non-discriminatory terms』とFRAND開放し、規制が『reduce barriers to entry』とも自認＝ロックを弱める側。よって70。

rows.quote: Competition within all of our markets is intense and is expected to remain so. Numerous competitors exist, many of which are larger than us in size. Global production overcapacity has also had an impact on operations within our Glassware and Candles segment.
rows.note: MZTI＝Lancaster Colony（FY2012/6期・食品＋ガラス製品/キャンドル）。原本は多数競合と生産過剰による価格下押しを述べるのみで、認証・設計組込・移行費用の記述ゼロ＝50。

rows.quote: These products must conform to highly prescribed specifications developed by vehicle OEMs for specific models or designs.
rows.note: 添加剤パッケージが顧客・OEMの規格に合わせて個別処方される（『engineered to meet specifications prescribed by either the industry or a specific customer』『formulations that are tailored to our customers’ ... specific needs』）＝深い処方統合で70。ただし『顧客が再認定をやり直す』という記述は全文走査でも無く、OEM approval を当社が取る側の記述も無いので85ではない。

rows.quote: NNN generally competes with numerous other REITs, commercial developers, real estate limited partnerships and other investors, including but not limited to insurance companies, pension funds and financial institutions that own, manage, finance or develop reta
rows.note: ネットリースREIT。原本は物件取得での多数競合を述べるのみ（『Competition ... may impede NNN’s ability to grow』）。テナント側の移行障壁・認証の記述は皆無＝50。

rows.quote: Key characteristics of our industry include long operating cycles and intense competition, which is evident through the number of bid protests (competitor protests of U.S. government procurement awards) and the number of competitors bidding on program opportunities.
rows.note: 防衛プライム。原本は入札競争・bid protestの増加、顧客が『source work internally』し得ることまで述べ、顧客側の再認定や移行費用は一言も無い。『supply sources approved by the U.S. Government』は当社が調達する側＝向きが逆なので採らない。長期契約・受注残40.8十億$は85の条件（顧客側の負担）に当たらないので50。

rows.quote: There are relatively few barriers to entry into the Company’s market, and the Company expects increased competition in its market which could adversely affect the Company’s operating results through pricing pressure, increased marketing expenditures, and market share losses
rows.note: NRC＝National Research Corporation（医療機関向け市場調査）。会社自身が『relatively few barriers to entry』と明言し、顧客の内製部門とも競合すると述べる＝50。

rows.quote: There is continuing strong competition among rail, water, and highway carriers. Price is usually only one factor of importance as shippers and receivers choose a transport mode and specific hauling company.
rows.note: 鉄道。原本は荷主がモードと運送会社を選べる強い競争を述べる。唯一の『high barriers of entry』は機関車・車両の供給者側の話で当社の堀ではない（向きが逆）。captive shipper・単一線独占の記述は走査しても無し＝50。物理網の代替不能性は主観(moat5)に反映。

rows.quote: While there may be restrictions on the location of a so-called "sexually oriented business", there are low barriers to entry into the adult cabaret entertainment market.
rows.note: 原本が自ら「参入障壁は低い」「adult entertainment business is highly competitive with respect to price, service and location」と述べ、各クラブは地元の同業と競合。移行障壁の記述は一切なし＝50。

rows.quote: We face intense competition from numerous competitors.
rows.note: Item1は「limited number of competitors」「leader in most of our markets」とニッチ優位を主張するが、リスク項目は多数競合＋価格を競争要因に挙げる。switch/qualification/install base を走査しても顧客側の移行摩擦・再認定の記述はゼロ。

rows.quote: Competition for collection accounts is primarily based on price and the quality of services.
rows.note: 排他的フランチャイズは「generally secure by competitive bid」で1-5年＝競争入札で入れ替わる。障壁は許認可・資本（供給側）で、顧客側の再認定は無い。

rows.quote: because our towers are strategically positioned and our customers typically do not relocate, we have historically experienced low tenant lease terminations as a percentage of revenue
rows.note: 顧客が実際に移設せず解約が低いと完了形で断定＝高摩擦移行困難。ただし第三者・顧客による再認定の記述は無く、競合はAmerican Tower等が存在するので85には届かない。

rows.quote: We employ our vessels in a highly competitive market that is capital intensive and highly fragmented, and competition arises primarily from other vessel owners.
rows.note: 原本が自ら「highly fragmented」「competition ... depends on charter rates」と述べる。代替容易の典型＝50。

rows.quote: We face substantial competition from many international, national, regional and local competitors of various sizes in the manufacture, distribution and sale of our paint, coatings and related products.
rows.note: 多数の同等供給者＋「price are the key competitive factors」を原本が明記。塗料の顧客側再認定・移行費用の記述は無い。

rows.quote: We face substantial competition from other providers of radio and other audio services.
rows.note: OEM工場装着（設計組込に近い）はあるが顧客＝購読者で、原本は地上波・Pandora等が「compete directly with our services」と明記し競争は増すと述べる。唯一供給の断定も無し。

rows.quote: In addition, we face competition from regional competitors who compete primarily on the basis of price for commodity growing media products.
rows.note: Spectrum/Bayer/Central Garden等を名指しし価格競争を自認。しかも顧客はHome Depot32.2%等の小売で「We face strong competition for the business of these significant customers」＝移行障壁は当社側に無い。

rows.quote: The retail industry is dynamic and competitive. We compete with numerous merchandise distribution channels including malls, outlet centers, community/lifestyle centers, and other shopping centers in the United States and abroad.
rows.note: テナント（顧客）は他モール・EC等の代替を持つと原本が明記（「The existence of competitive alternatives could have a material adverse effect on our ability to lease space」）。立地の優位は主張するが移行の顧客負担の記述なし。

rows.quote: The market for financial services software and services is competitive, rapidly evolving and highly sensitive to new product introductions and marketing efforts by industry participants, although high conversion costs can create barriers to adoption of new products or technologies.
rows.note: 「high conversion costs」＝顧客が乗り換えに費用を払うと断定＝高摩擦移行困難で70。ただし同じ文が市場は「fragmented」とも述べ、顧客側の再認定・データ再生成の記述は無いので85には当たらない。

rows.quote: The beverage alcohol industry is highly competitive. The Company competes on the basis of quality, price, brand recognition and distribution strength.
rows.note: 原本が価格を競争要因に挙げ「compete with other alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages for consumer」と代替の広さを自認。sole sourceの語はあるが当社が供給を受ける側（Nava醸造所依存）＝向きが逆で堀の証拠にならない。

rows.quote: As a result, we rely on OEMs and ODMs of wireless communications electronics products to select our products from among alternative offerings to be designed into their equipment. Without these "design wins," we would have difficulty selling our products. If a manufacturer designs another supplier's product into one of its product platforms, it is more difficult for us to achieve future design wins with that platform
rows.note: 設計組込（design win）による platform 単位の固着はあるが、文型は依存・願望形（『我々が選ばれることに依存する』『alternative offerings の中から』）で顧客側の再認定の断定は皆無。Competition節は Analog Devices/Avago/RFMD 等を名指しし『declining average selling prices』と価格競争を自認するため85には遠い。qualification の語は自社の foundry 認定（自社側）でのみ登場。

rows.quote: In all of our product lines we compete with local and global companies located throughout the world. Competition exists in all product lines without regard to the number and size of the competing companies involved.
rows.note: switch/qualification/requalify/顧客側の再認定を全文走査したが記述ゼロ。approval は自社取得の 510(k)/PMA のみ（規約の除外対象）。原本は全製品ラインで競争があり『Competitive factors include price...』と価格を挙げ、『products could be rendered obsolete』とするので50。堀の実感（特許1,687件・直販網・規模）は強いが原本の移行障壁記述は無い。

rows.quote: The market for transaction-based and specialty printing solutions is extremely competitive, and we expect such competition to continue in the future. We compete with a number of companies, many of which have greater financial, technical and marketing resources than us.
rows.note: OEM向け custom printer の共同設計はあるが、原本の支配的記述は『extremely competitive』＋自社より資源の大きい競合多数。GTECHとの排他購入契約(2015年1月まで)は契約上の排他＝規約が85から明示除外する『単なる長期取引・顧客集中』の型。よって50。

rows.quote: We operate in the intensely competitive IT industry, which is characterized by rapidly changing technology, evolving industry standards and models for consuming and delivering business and IT services, frequent new product introductions, and price and cost reductions.
rows.note: switch/migrat/lock/installed base を走査したが顧客側の移行費用の記述なし。『very competitive, and we face competition for nearly every sales opportunity we pursue』＋『aggressive price discounting』『pressure on price/performance』＝価格競争を自認。既存顧客の増設・保守収入という粘着の事実はあるが障壁としては述べていない。

rows.quote: The hospitality industry is highly competitive and we are subject to risks relating to competition that may adversely affect our performance. We will be adversely impacted if we cannot compete effectively in the highly competitive hospitality industry. Our continued success depends upon our ability to compete effectively in markets that contain numerous competitors, some of which may have significantly greater financial, marketing and other resources than we have. Competition may reduce fee structures, potentially causing us to lower our fees or prices
rows.note: 15-20年のフランチャイズ契約はあるが『non-exclusive use』かつ原本自身が『franchisees who have the right to terminate their existing franchise affiliations with other lodging brands』とブランド乗り換えを前提に記述＝移行障壁の主張ではない。手数料の下方圧力も明記され50。RCI交換網（会員85%超維持）は堀だが irr の型ではない。

rows.quote: The domestic confectionery business is highly competitive. The Company competes primarily with other manufacturers of bar candy, bagged candy and bubble gum of the type sold in the above mentioned stores. Although accurate statistics are not available, the Company believes it is among the ten largest domestic manufacturers in this field.
rows.note: 自社を『ten largest の一角』と位置づけ、競争は『brand recognition as well as a fair price』＝ブランドと価格。さらに『Discounting and pricing pressure by the Company's retail customers』と小売側の値引き圧力・Wal-Mart 23.5%依存を自認。顧客側の認定・移行費用の記述は皆無で50。

rows.quote: The insurance industry is represented in the commercial marketplace by many insurance companies of varying size as well as other entities offering risk alternatives, such as self-insured retentions or captive programs.
rows.note: 多数の同業＋自家保険・キャプティブという代替まで原本が列挙し、各市場で『Competition in this market is primarily based on product offerings, service levels, ease of doing business and price』と価格を明記。独立代理店経由の販売で顧客側の再認定という概念自体が存在しない＝50。

rows.quote: Custom products are designed for a specific customer for a specific application, are sold only to that customer and are typically sold directly to the customer.
rows.note: custom品の設計組込と、catalog品の『The majority of our catalog products are proprietary』『life cycles ... span multiple years, with some products continuing to sell for decades』＝設計に入ると長く残る事実記述はある。だが顧客側の再認定・再試験の断定は一つも無く、Competitive landscape は競合10社超を名指しし価格を競争要因に挙げるため85ではなく70。

rows.quote: The domestic propane retail distribution business is highly competitive. The Partnership competes in this business with other large propane marketers, including other full-service marketers, and thousands of small independent operators.
rows.note: 『thousands of small independent operators』＝断片化を原本が明言、卸は『highly competitive, low margin business』で入札制。燃料転換には機器入替が要る（fuel oil↔propane）が、これは他燃料への転換の話で propane 業者間の乗り換え障壁ではない。貯蔵タンクのリース所有は摩擦だが障壁としての記述なし＝50。

rows.quote: The uniform rental and sales industry is highly competitive. The principal methods of competition in the industry are the quality of products, the quality of service and price.
rows.note: 3-5年の書面サービス契約と自社製造のカスタム衣料プログラムはあるが、原本は『our current customers will not turn to competitors, cease operations, elect to self-operate or terminate contracts with us』と乗り換え・内製化のリスクを自認し、競争要因に price を明記。顧客側の再認定の記述なし＝50。

rows.quote: We provide the infrastructure for an Internet presence that extends to tens of thousands of customers who have integrated UPS tools directly into their own web sites.
rows.note: 顧客業務システムへの深い統合を完了形の事実として記述（『customers to integrate UPS functionality into their own businesses』を含む）＝70の『深い統合』に該当。ただし認定・再認定の機構は無く（certification の語は年金ゾーンと集団訴訟の認定のみ）、Risk Factors は『We face significant competition on a local, regional, national and international basis』＋競合が出せる価格条件に言及するため85には当たらない。

rows.quote: The lime industry is highly regionalized and competitive, with quality, price, ability to meet customer demands and specifications, proximity to customers, personal relationships and timeliness of deliveries being the prime competitive factors.
rows.note: 原本が競争要因の筆頭に品質と価格を置き、顧客側の再認定も切替費用も一切書いていない。高い参入障壁は述べるが中身は石灰石鉱区の希少性・許認可・立地＝供給側の障壁で、顧客が乗り換える負担の記述ではない。

rows.quote: These agreements, which range in terms from one to thirteen years, can provide card issuance and/or conversion support, volume / growth targets and marketing and program support based on specific performance requirements.
rows.note: 最長13年の顧客契約＋当社が『conversion support』を負担する記述＝乗り換えに費用が要ることの間接証拠、加えてVisaNetへの接続と共通operating regulationsへの服従＝深い統合で70。顧客側の再認定の断定は全文になく85は取れない（Durbinで複数ネット併載・ルーティング選択が義務化された記述はむしろ摩擦を下げる側）。

rows.quote: The apparel and footwear industries are highly competitive, and VF's success depends on its ability to respond to constantly changing markets. VF competes with numerous apparel and footwear brands and manufacturers. Competition is generally based upon brand name recognition, price, design, product quality, selection, service and purchasing convenience.
rows.note: 原本自身が多数の競合と価格を競争基盤に挙げる。qualification/certification の語は自社工場のWRAP認証と契約工場の事前認証＝当社が取得・課す側で、顧客側の負担は皆無。

rows.quote: These groups mandate rigorous manufacturer certification, new product testing and approval processes that we believe are difficult for new entrants to meet cost-effectively and efficiently without the scale and extensive experience we possess.
rows.note: AAR/FRAが製造者認定と新製品試験・承認を課す＝第三者認定の機構は実在するが、原本の書きぶりは『新規参入者に難しい』であって顧客側の再認定費用の断定が無いので70。補強材料に『Our substantial installed base ... these customers often look to purchase safety- and performance-related replacement parts from the original equipment components supplier』＋新製品は既存機器とinteroperableである必要、がある一方で『Price competition is strong because we have a relatively small number of customers and they are very cost-conscious』と自認。

rows.quote: Due to the commodity nature of many of our products, competition in these markets is based primarily on price and to a lesser extent on performance, product quality, product deliverability and customer service. As a result, we generally are not able to protect our market position for these products by product differentiation and may not be able to pass on cost increases to our customers.
rows.note: 会社自身が商品性（コモディティ）と価格競争、製品差別化で市場地位を守れないことを明言。認定・切替費用の記述は全文に無い。

rows.quote: New products that we develop may require separate approval as medical devices, and products that are intended to be used in packaging and delivery of pharmaceutical products will be subject to both customer acceptance of our products and regulatory approval of the customer's products following our development period.
rows.note: 部材の採用に『顧客の製品の側の規制当局承認』が必要と原本が明記＝再認定の費用が顧客側に落ちる機構。ただし書きぶりは新製品の採用（これから承認を得る）方向で、既存供給者を外すと顧客が再申請を要するという完了形の断定は無い＝85の中では弱い型として記録する。『Commercial development ... commonly requires several years』も併記。

rows.quote: Aerospace industry safety regulations and manufacturing standards demand significant product certification requirements, which form a basis for competition as well as a barrier to entry.
rows.note: 政府規制による製品認定＋OEMの機体・エンジン計画への設計組込（G650/F-35等に content）と据付機のアフター供給で移行摩擦はあるが、認定は当社が取得する側で顧客側の再認定負担の記述が無いので70。減点材料として原本が『many of our OEM customers are capable of developing and manufacturing these same products internally』『Several competitors are also customers』と自認。

rows.quote: The retail food industry, in which our Concepts compete, is made up of supermarkets, supercenters, warehouse stores, convenience stores, coffee shops, snack bars, delicatessens and restaurants (including the QSR segment), and is intensely competitive with respect to food quality, price, service, convenience, location and concept.
rows.note: 消費者が毎回選び直す業態で、原本も価格・立地・利便性の激烈な競争と自認。認定・切替費用の語は全文で訴訟のclass certificationしか出ない。

rows.quote: The supplies business is highly fragmented and competition is comprised of numerous competitors of various sizes depending on the geographic area.
rows.note: 競合を40社以上実名で列挙し、カード印刷では代替技術（ink-jet・embossing・laser engraving等）とサービスビューローが『viable alternatives』と明記。certificationの語は自社がVAR（販売店）に与える認定＝向きが逆。1,190万台の据付台数はあるが顧客側の移行障壁の記述は無い。
